name: rungic-plasma-config
description:
Plasma Mobile on Android: system configuration
APT sources, pins and the unattended-upgrades blacklist of the release repository;
the default state of services the container keeps off (service-policy.json, applied once);
sshd settings for the optional SSH login; journald, PipeWire, WirePlumber, D-Bus and GPU environment
settings; system defaults in /etc/xdg; Blender renders on the CPU with half the cores by default (docs/90); one-time per-user migrations (kconf_update). Removes the /usr/local copies of rebuilt
Ubuntu programs (plasma-settings, the KDE portal) that shadowed the packaged ones.
See docs/61-delivery-diagnostics-plan.md.
